description.en: Registers a pinball-style bumper hazard on the match field, at a given position with a set of shape/behavior parameters.
3-element array [x, y, z] with the bumper's position.
True once the bumper has been registered; null if fewer than 3 arguments were given.

example.code:
// Register a pinball-style bumper hazard on the field
CMND_BTL_REG_BUMPER(v, h, w, c, min, max);
